CPU-only callback uses separate work budget; no progress still consumes a callback; finite always-ready schedule is not an unconditional liveness proof
Actual LT repeats readiness after read2 of5; ET does not; explicit runnable carry drains remaining3 to EAGAIN
Actual EPOLLONESHOT disables notification; byte arriving after drain before MOD is reported after rearm

Reduced generation range retires slot permanently after its final generation; stale completion cannot access new operation storage
Three-ready schedule observes per-connection2 and global8 quotas; independent ordered-list oracle covers12288 mask/cursor/work/type cells
Reentrant ready publication enters next turn only; nested turn rejected; snapshot and callback budget prevent recursive expansion
Actual four-connection bounded service and imported RfOutbox; three overload policies preserve rejected caller ownership and settle disconnected work
Variable lengths under297 independent count/byte cells; empty frames still consume slots and finite64-ID lifetime ledger rejects exhaustion
Actual32 accepted messages settle1completed/31cancelled after observed absolute deadline and callback return; repeated stop preserves one terminal per ID
Reentrant stop enters cancellation but retains pending message ownership AND service storage until final callback return; no asynchronous kernel-buffer release inference
Actual mutex-enrolled empty consumer/full producer/peer EOF and repeated stop; predicate-free notification rechecks condition
